name: Suspicious Processes Spawned by Java.EXE
description: Detects suspicious processes spawned from a Java host process which could indicate a sign of exploitation (e.g. log4j)
author: GAI_CTI
query: process.parent.executable:*\\java.exe AND (process.executable:(*\\AppVLP.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\curl.exe OR *\\forfiles.exe OR *\\hh.exe OR *\\mftrace.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\query.exe OR *\\reg.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\schtasks.exe OR *\\scrcons.exe OR *\\scriptrunner.exe OR *\\sh.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\wscript.exe))
